gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-fs-supreme: Crisp, dense, heavy-looking text, with each letter held open rather than curled shut. Supreme sits under Baloo Tammudu 2, whose tall rounded lowercase gives the heading its commanding voice.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-general-sans: Baloo Tammudu 2 stands tall and rounded up top, its e opening wide instead of closing its eye. General Sans glides at steady pressure around every bend, and that smoothness is the quiet heart of the pairing.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-manrope: Tall, rounded lowercase forms give Baloo Tammudu 2 its commanding stance, with the e opening up wide. Manrope holds one line width throughout and leaves bright gaps at each curve, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-montserrat: Distinctive from the first word, Baloo Tammudu 2 stacks tall rounded lowercase into a heading with real presence. Montserrat is best at gliding along like wire, with oversized a and e counters, leaving attention-grabbing to the heading.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-satoshi: Satoshi stands tall with a soaring x-height and an e that never looks squeezed shut. And Baloo Tammudu 2 brings rounded, commanding lowercase on top, while every Satoshi stroke keeps one width.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-switzer: Wire-like and approachably Swiss, Switzer keeps its c tips well apart. Baloo Tammudu 2 is the one for making noise with tall rounded lowercase, while Switzer's job is holding thickness steady around every curve.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-work-sans: Work Sans feels contemporary, with c tips held apart and a mean line set high. Work Sans at a generous text size lets its parallel curves show against the tall, rounded lowercase of Baloo Tammudu 2.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-archivo: Baloo Thambi 2 gives the lowercase a deep midsection and distinct gaps in c, e and s. And Archivo, with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height, can go a touch smaller in text without losing presence.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-fs-asap: Readable and open, with c forms like gentle arcs and a body height nearly matching the capitals. Asap carries that quiet job beneath Baloo Thambi 2, whose deep-bodied lowercase does the expressive talking up top.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Baloo Thambi 2 swells through the middle of its lowercase, leaving distinct gaps in c, e and s. Be Vietnam Pro's strokes, like bent steel rod at one thickness, are what hold the two together.
